arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/tests && cat > t_prep.py <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from harness import run, t, done

load = {'op':'load','n':3,'links':[[0,1,10],[1,2,10]],'bookings':[]}
prep = {'op':'prepare','id':'p1','owner':'alice','window':[0,4],'period':2,
        'participants':[[0,2],[2,3]],'envelope':[[0,4],[1,4]],'rev':0}

r = run([load, prep])
print('prepare reply:', r[1]['status'], r[1].get('plan') and 'plan' or r[1])
t('prepare ok', r[1]['status'], 'prepared')

r2 = run([load, prep, prep])
t('prepare replay', r2[2], {'status':'replay','id':'p1','rev':0,'base_rev':0,'outcome':'prepared'})

prep2 = dict(prep, owner='bob')
t('prepare conflict', run([load, prep, prep2])[2], {'status':'error','code':'CONFLICT','rev':0})
t('prepare conflict rev', run([load, prep, dict(prep, rev=1)])[2],
  {'status':'error','code':'CONFLICT','rev':0})
t('prepare load id', run([load, dict(prep, id='b1')])[1],
  {'status':'error','code':'CONFLICT','rev':0})

p = dict(prep, id='p2')
t('prep stale', run([load, dict(p, rev=3)])[1], {'status':'stale','rev':0})
t('prep ref', run([load, dict(p, participants=[[0,2],[5,3]])])[1],
  {'status':'error','code':'REFERENCE','rev':0})
t('prep ref2', run([load, dict(p, envelope=[[9,4]])])[1],
  {'status':'error','code':'REFERENCE','rev':0})
t('prep time', run([load, {'op':'advance','time':5}, dict(p, rev=1)])[2],
  {'status':'error','code':'TIME','rev':1})
t('prep window', run([load, dict(p, period=3)])[1],
  {'status':'error','code':'WINDOW','rev':0})
r = run([load, dict(p, rev=3), dict(p, rev=0)])
t('prep retry after fail', (r[1]['status'], r[2]['status']), ('stale', 'prepared'))

r = run([load, prep, {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0}])
print('commit reply:', r[2])
t('commit ok', r[2], {'status':'ok','id':'p1','rev':1,'replay':False})
r = run([load, prep, {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0},
         {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0}])
t('commit replay', r[3], {'status':'ok','id':'p1','rev':2,'replay':True})
t('commit missing', run([load, {'op':'commit','id':'zz','owner':'a','rev':0}])[1],
  {'status':'error','code':'MISSING','rev':0})
t('commit owner', run([load, prep, {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'mallory','rev':0}])[2],
  {'status':'error','code':'OWNER','rev':0})
r = run([load, prep, {'op':'advance','time':0}, {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0}])
t('commit stale', r[3], {'status':'stale','rev':1})

deny = {'op':'prepare','id':'p3','owner':'alice','window':[0,4],'period':2,
        'participants':[[0,2],[2,3]],'envelope':[[0,30]],'rev':0}
r = run([load, deny, {'op':'commit','id':'p3','owner':'alice','rev':0}])
print('denied reply:', r[1])
t('commit denied', r[2], {'status':'error','code':'DENIED','rev':0})

r = run([load, prep, {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0},
         {'op':'cancel','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':1},
         {'op':'cancel','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':2}])
t('cancel ok', r[3], {'status':'ok','rev':2,'released':'p1'})
t('cancel again', r[4], {'status':'error','code':'MISSING','rev':2})
t('cancel prepared -> missing', run([load, prep, {'op':'cancel','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0}])[2],
  {'status':'error','code':'MISSING','rev':0})
r = run([load, prep, {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0},
         {'op':'cancel','id':'p1','owner':'mallory','rev':1}])
t('cancel owner', r[3], {'status':'error','code':'OWNER','rev':1})
t('cancel stale', run([load, prep, {'op':'cancel','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':7}])[2],
  {'status':'stale','rev':0})

r = run([load, prep, {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0},
         {'op':'advance','time':4},
         {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':2}])
t('commit gone', r[4], {'status':'error','code':'GONE','rev':2})

# commit installs the whole window+envelope: audit must show it
r = run([load, prep, {'op':'commit','id':'p1','owner':'alice','rev':0},
         {'op':'audit','at':[2]}])
t('commit installs', r[3]['samples'], [[2, [10-4, 10-4]]])

# denied is recorded forever: replay of denial
r = run([load, deny, deny])
t('denied replay', r[2], {'status':'replay','id':'p3','rev':0,'base_rev':0,'outcome':'denied'})

done()
EOF
python3 t_prep.py
